claim: the launcher help (`help seasonal-wildlife`) describes the tool
expected: launcher help text
got:
seasonal-wildlife
=================

Tags: fort | gameplay | animals

A windowed tool to curate and seasonally rotate your embark's wildlife. Detects
the
creatures that can actually visit your fort (per biome), lets you allow/block
them, set
relative abundance, and assign each to seasons via a preference/food-web matrix.
All
changes are live (no reload), including adding a species not native to the
embark.

Seven tabs: Overview (what the map holds now, the next boundary, the recent
ledger),
Roster (curate + filter + apply), Set roster (per-category targets, fill natural
prey/predators, season grid with S/U/A/W row toggles, matrix assign, co-align),
Food web
(predator->prey chains, filterable by season), Live (groups on the map, the
ecology line,
quotas, the cavern line, biomass), Seasons (four columns, arrivals and
departures marked)
and Vermin (the vermin roster by family). The window is
gui/seasonal-wildlife.lua; this script is the engine
and the console.

Usage::

    gui/seasonal-wildlife            open the window
    seasonal-wildlife status         the embark's manageable creatures, layers,
    quotas, fuse line
    seasonal-wildlife now            apply the current season's roster once
    seasonal-wildlife enable|disable automatic seasonal rotation on/off
    seasonal-wildlife groups
    [on|off|ecology|livestock|cavern|nudge|hold|dismiss|pack ...]
                                     resident groups, the ecology switch,
                                     cohesion
